title: Email: Fw: Many of us miss you!

content.subject: Fw: Many of us miss you!

content.text:
From: T <timbuktom1@gmail.com>
Sent: Tuesday, September 1, 2020 10:21 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Many of us miss you! 
 
Dear Anthony,
No more baseball for you? Sorry. Are you still involved with the Free Press?
You have been my favorite sports writer of the 21st century. In the future, wherever you go, please contact me for quick edits, re grammar and such.
Good luck!
